purpose: Classify the evidence and runtime permission behind every material decision rule.

sources.title: Solana token and Token-2022 documentation
sources.limits: Defines capabilities and state, not whether a token is fraudulent or profitable.

sources.title: Solana RPC send, simulation and status documentation
sources.limits: Simulation and node acceptance are point-in-time states, not landing or fill guarantees.

sources.title: Jupiter Swap API
sources.limits: Expected quote/order values are not confirmed fills.

sources.limits: Bundle or send acceptance is not landing; exact landed-bundle evidence requires status, landing slot and included transaction signatures, and the low-latency send path skips preflight.

sources.title: Helius data streaming and Sender documentation
sources.limits: Documents access and delivery capabilities, not predictive edge.

sources.title: MELT: A Behavioral Trace Dataset for High-Risk Memecoin Launch Detection
sources.limits: Migrated launches only, inferred risk labels, older migration regime; public assets are non-commercially licensed.

sources.title: Catching the Rug: Early Prediction of Fraudulent Memecoins on Solana via Machine Learning
sources.limits: Outcome labels are imperfect, cross-venue transfer is weak, and authors state it is not deployment-ready.

sources.title: From Hype to Collapse: Investigating Rug Pull Scams on Solana
sources.limits: Behavior detector can miss slower attacks and is not a return model.

sources.title: Predicting the success of new crypto-tokens: the Pump.fun case
sources.limits: One month; graduation rather than follower return; wallet uplift was modest and non-monotonic.

sources.title: Resisting Manipulative Bots in Meme Coin Copy Trading
sources.limits: Heuristic bot labels, LLM-classified content and one historical sample; not independent live proof.

sources.title: A Midsummer Meme's Dream: Investigating Market Manipulations in the Meme Coin Ecosystem
sources.limits: Cross-chain selected samples and heuristic manipulation detection; not a forward entry model.

sources.title: A Trend Factor for the Cross Section of Cryptocurrency Returns
sources.limits: Broader and more liquid assets at much longer horizons than Pump.fun.

sources.title: Cryptocurrency momentum has (not) its moments
sources.limits: Different universe and horizon, but strong evidence that momentum is unstable and crash-prone.

sources.title: Social Media-Based Attention and the Cross-Section of Cryptocurrency Returns
sources.limits: Daily horizon, possible reverse causality and no minute-scale Solana validation.

sources.title: Social media engagement and cryptocurrency performance
sources.limits: New-coin sample and social-bot confounding; does not validate a direct buy trigger.

sources.title: Why Does My Transaction Fail? A First Look at Failed Transactions on the Solana Blockchain
sources.limits: Historical program mix and bot-classification uncertainty; measured failure rate must not be transplanted.

sources.title: Quantifying the Threat of Sandwiching MEV on Jito
sources.limits: Historical Jito-focused window and lower-bound loss estimate.

sources.title: The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
sources.limits: Application must preserve blocked and dependent time-series structure.

sources.title: The Deflated Sharpe Ratio
sources.limits: Requires a truthful record of trials and assumptions about return dependence.

sources.title: Pump.fun fees and SOL/USDC quote support
sources.limits: Fee and quote-mint behavior is versioned and can change; current documentation is not a predictive model.

sources.title: DEX Screener API and Trending documentation
sources.limits: The public pair API does not document unique-maker counts, and Trending does not publish weights or decision thresholds.

sources.title: Birdeye token trade and holder data documentation
sources.limits: Token/pair scope, chain support, wallet/token-account mode, windows and credit costs vary by endpoint.

sources.title: GMGN market field and safe-preset reference
sources.limits: Vendor labels and example cutoffs are provider-specific; published descriptions of bundler_rate do not establish one denominator, while bundler_trader_amount_rate is a trading-volume ratio.

sources.title: Axiom Pulse and bundle-checker documentation
sources.limits: Documents product fields and potential-bundle heuristics, not calibrated profitability thresholds.

sources.title: X Post Counts API
sources.limits: Counts measure matching posts, not unique humans, sentiment quality, ownership or causal price impact.

sources.title: Telegram Bot API visibility rules
sources.limits: Collection coverage depends on chat membership, admin/privacy mode, and bots cannot see messages from other bots.

sources.title: Pump.fun Graduation Regime Windows
sources.limits: Effective collection was about six minutes, graduation is not net return, and the reported rate is a fast-window lower bound rather than a 24-hour estimate.

sources.title: Current versioned policy
sources.limits: Contains initial hypotheses and conservative controls, not externally validated optima.

rules.claim: Resolve and decode the exact mint, program, venue, stage, curve or pool relationships from fresh chain state.
rules.limits: A provider badge cannot replace program/account verification.

rules.claim: Decode mint and freeze authorities and all supported Token-2022 extensions at every venue stage; reject unsupported or presently unsellable behavior.
rules.limits: Bonding-curve stage does not make authority state not applicable. Unknown stays unknown; an active capability is not proof of fraud and exclusion is a risk policy.

rules.claim: Simulate the exact final allowlisted transaction before signing, including an executable exit path where applicable.
rules.limits: Simulation is point-in-time and cannot guarantee landing or future sellability.

rules.claim: Create fills and PnL only from confirmed chain metadata and balance deltas; monitor finality and terminal failures.
rules.limits: Operational commitment and rollback handling must be explicit.

rules.claim: Every feature and entity result must be available at the decision cutoff with event and observation timestamps.
rules.limits: Historical provider snapshots may be unavailable and must be marked missing rather than reconstructed from future state.

rules.claim: Compare raw and typed-entity-adjusted early/top-holder concentration.
rules.limits: Co-funding and bundle relationships can produce false ownership links; cutoffs are not portable.

rules.claim: Use only prior creator, funder, LP and profit-recipient outcomes as typed risk evidence.
rules.limits: Shared services/exchanges and community takeovers can create false associations.

rules.claim: Train and calibrate adverse-outcome models separately by venue and lifecycle stage.
rules.limits: Even a venue-specific model can decay across program versions and regimes.

rules.claim: Test curve/net-inflow velocity jointly with independent buyer breadth, entity concentration and wash authenticity.
rules.limits: Fast progression can signal either organic demand or coordinated high-risk inventory; no published coefficient is portable.

rules.claim: Estimate decayed wallet/entity quality from prior closed outcomes, uncertainty, drawdown, entry and exit behavior.
rules.limits: Persistence may be weak, crowded, insider-driven or luck; wallet addresses are not necessarily entities.

rules.claim: Test multi-horizon price, volume and volatility trend as a conditional feature.
rules.limits: Published evidence conflicts and is at longer horizons; momentum can be crash-prone.

rules.claim: Test mint-linked, decaying attention surprise with independent-author breadth and bot/coordination penalties.
rules.limits: Daily studies do not validate minute-scale entry; attention can follow price and be manufactured.

rules.claim: Predict follower return after leader-to-follower delay, curve/price impact, exit latency and every cost rather than copying leader PnL.
rules.limits: The direction is structural; the magnitude varies by state, size and latency.

rules.claim: Model route/protocol/platform/creator fees, tips, impact, drift, MEV, failures and exit costs for every intent.
rules.limits: Cost and failure distributions are regime-, route-, size- and provider-dependent.

rules.claim: Use chronological train/tune/test, purge overlapping labels and stress unseen creator/funder/entity groups.
rules.limits: Window, embargo and retraining cadence require data-dependent selection inside training data.

rules.claim: Log every trial and apply a predeclared backtest-overfitting or multiple-testing correction before promotion.
rules.limits: A corrected statistic still does not guarantee future profit.

rules.claim: Current alert threshold is 10000 USD.
rules.limits: No reviewed source establishes 10000 USD as return-optimal.

rules.claim: Current limits are 15 seconds maximum data age and 15 percent maximum copy move.
rules.limits: Opportunity decay depends on route, age, liquidity, leader size, latency and regime.

rules.claim: Current caps are 2 percent estimated impact and 8 percent required slippage.
rules.limits: They are conservative caps, not optimal targets; use all-in loss and failure trade-offs.

rules.claim: Current graduated-token cutoffs include 30 SOL liquidity, 25 percent top-10, 10 percent related early holders and 3M USD market cap.
rules.limits: Feature families are supported but these universal cutoffs are not.

rules.claim: Current policy asks for three independent Tier-A entities for automatic-execution consideration.
rules.limits: No reviewed study validates three; correlated/copying entities are not independent.

rules.claim: Current research flags use 10x volume acceleration and 30 percent 24-hour holder growth.
rules.limits: Growth can be manipulated, sybil-inflated or distorted from a near-zero baseline.

rules.claim: Current 0-100 weights and 75/60 tier cutoffs are an interpretable starting hypothesis.
rules.limits: The weights and cutoffs have not been fit or calibrated on a point-in-time project dataset.

rules.claim: One hundred eligible signals and seven calendar days are pipeline smoke-test minima.
rules.limits: They cannot establish statistical sufficiency or unlock live status.

rules.claim: Current position, total exposure, daily/weekly loss and consecutive-loss caps are conservative governance limits.
rules.limits: They are not profit-optimal and require ruin, drawdown and dependence stress before any live proposal.

rules.claim: A third-party smart-money, insider, security, organic or PnL label is not canonical truth.
rules.limits: Store provider definition/version, timestamp, confidence, raw evidence and contradictions.

rules.claim: Same funder, bundle, transaction or popular token does not by itself prove common beneficial ownership.
rules.limits: Edges remain typed, source-specific and confidence-weighted with exchange/service exclusions.

rules.claim: Graduation, migration, LP handling or renounced authority does not prove fair distribution, sellability or profit.
rules.limits: Verify current state, distribution, executable exit, canonical pool and post-migration behavior separately; generic present-time LP burn status is insufficient.

rules.claim: Emit pump_curve_active for complete=false, migration_pending for complete=true without the canonical PumpSwap pool, and pumpswap_amm only when that pool exists, using pinned current program and account configuration.
rules.limits: Curve completion is not completed migration. Roughly 69000 USD or 85 SOL is current default-SOL configuration shorthand, non-universal, and deprecated as a lifecycle-stage classifier.

rules.claim: Current canonical Pump migration is a separate permissionless and idempotent PumpSwap operation, and its initial LP issuance is burned.
rules.limits: The legacy Raydium withdrawal path is disabled. Later PumpSwap deposits can mint LP and withdrawals can redeem it, so generic current LP burn or supply status cannot prove canonical migration or deployer control.

rules.claim: Measure aligned executed flow, raw and entity-adjusted breadth, ownership change, concentration, executable depth and mint-linked attention jointly.
rules.limits: No component or fixed public threshold is a universal buy signal; address counts remain Sybil-sensitive.

rules.claim: Keep same-slot candidates, landed exact-Jito bundles, funding-linked clusters, supply shares and retained shares in separate versioned cohorts; store provider labels outside those cohorts with explicit denominators.
rules.limits: Exact Jito requires landed status, landing slot and included signatures. Even exact membership proves coordinated submission rather than common beneficial ownership or malicious intent; GMGN bundler_rate remains unspecified while bundler_trader_amount_rate is trading-volume share.

rules.claim: Evaluate entry and full-exit feasibility using fresh quotes and simulation for the intended notional rather than absolute liquidity alone.
rules.limits: A current successful quote cannot guarantee future exit liquidity or a realized fill.

rules.claim: Test exact-mint-linked social presence, independent-author breadth and attention change separately for graduation, adverse outcomes and net follower return.
rules.limits: A recent fast-window study found a graduation association but had material coverage limitations and did not establish follower profit.

rules.claim: Supplied new-pair, curve, migration, post-graduation, copy, exit and risk bands are retained only as named research candidates.
rules.limits: No reviewed source establishes the full preset stack or its exact dollar, count, percentage and time thresholds as return-optimal.

rules.claim: The roughly 69000 USD or 85 SOL shorthand associated with the current default-SOL configuration cannot identify Pump lifecycle stage.
rules.limits: It is non-universal across program parameters, quote mint, SOL price and config versions; inspect curve completion and canonical PumpSwap-pool state.

rules.claim: Mint or freeze authority cannot be represented as not applicable solely because a token is on a Pump bonding curve.
rules.limits: Read canonical authority state; preserve unknown on collection failure and apply any active-authority rejection as an explicit risk policy.

rules.claim: Raw volume or transaction count cannot be labeled organic demand without participation, route and manipulation evidence.
rules.limits: Turnover can be concentrated, routed, circular, wash-generated or split across Sybil wallets.

rules.claim: An LLM cannot possess keys, create arbitrary instructions or independently authorize a transaction.
rules.limits: LLMs may parse unstructured evidence and explain deterministic decisions only.
